dispute_ticket.description: My rider got into the car with very muddy shoes and left mud all over the front and rear floor mat. I took a photo right after and had the car valeted. Please charge the cleaning cost to the rider.

chat_logs.content: I'm at the MacRitchie carpark entrance, silver Altis.
Hi, there is a lot of mud on the floor mat. I will need to get the car cleaned.

app_events.details: Rider R-7201 booked trip RYDE-IM-001 from MacRitchie Reservoir Park to Bishan Junction 8.
Driver submitted cleaning claim S$60.00 with 1 photo (photo1.jpg). Claim filed after the driver's chat message at 17:20.
Driver submitted a SparkValet Pte Ltd receipt for S$60.00 (interior valet, floor mats) dated 2026-10-03 19:15.

cleaning_fee_max.text: The maximum cleaning fee in SGD that may be charged to a rider for one trip. The fee is paid to the driver.

cleaning_fee_recipient.text: A cleaning fee charged to a rider is credited to the driver who made the claim.

cleaning_claim_evidence_required.text: Evidence a driver should provide to support a cleaning fee claim against a rider. It governs driver cleaning claims only.

photo_window_after_dropoff_min.text: A cleaning claim needs at least one photo of the mess taken within 60 minutes after drop-off, at or near the drop-off point.

photo_doubt_rule.text: If a photo's authenticity, timing, place or content is in doubt and no other record settles the claim, a case officer decides.

rider_may_dispute_if.text: Lists the grounds on which a rider may dispute a cleaning fee charged to them.

evidence.description: Mud from the rider's shoes on the floor mat, taken after drop-off.

expected_outcome.reason: Photo1 was taken at 17:31, 12 minutes after drop-off at 17:19, under 100 m from the drop-off point (Bishan Junction 8), and shows muddy sneakers and mud on the floor mat. That is inside the 60-minute window and no record contradicts it. The SparkValet receipt for S$60.00 dated 2026-10-03 19:15 matches the claimed S$60.00, which is within this trip's S$150 cap. Upheld: S$60.00 is credited to the driver.

v21_change.why: Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 s6.1: the dispute value is above S$50 (always human review). The automatic ruling before v2.1 is kept under 'was' (D50).
